fusions.name: Paced Lash
fusions.desc: Pays out a strand that deals 8 damage to one enemy within 7 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 25%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one. Deals up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range.

fusions.name: Tripline
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone of strands along the ground ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Snare Underfoot
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to set a snare of strands at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 12 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles springs it, which deals 18 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Cordwain Soles
fusions.desc: Conjures soles of braided strands: your movement speed rises 8%, your stamina recovers 12% faster, your critical chance rises by 3% and your critical hits deal 0.1x more, and each kill returns 2 health.
